caveats: SSH status probes need key-based ssh from the daemon host to each managed host
Wake-on-LAN needs an L2 path to the target network; use the http/udp/microlink transports for routed targets
The command transport runs arbitrary shell from host config — host config is trusted
Wake secrets (bearer tokens, microlink HMAC keys) live in the plugin state dir, never in host records
Embedded MCP power tools are injected into agents by default; disable in settings if unwanted
